description:
FIRST post-MVP priority. Move beyond one user-selected language per recording. Determine which of three operating modes are feasible on-device via WebNN, and ship the best one(s):
(A) Select language: user picks one or a small set of languages per recording (MVP behavior, generalized).
(B) Per-line detection: detect language per spoken line / VAD utterance / speaker turn and route to matching per-language models (e.g. switching Moonshine checkpoints mid-recording).
(C) Fully mixed: first-class intra-sentential code-switching with token-level language tags.
Mode may differ between live and final passes (e.g. B live, C final). Soniox already does token-level LID natively. plan.md §2 (not in MVP), §6.1 live STT rationale.
title: Post-MVP: Multilingual support (language detection, routing, code-switching)
